# Brian Dominguez

> Brian Dominguez is an audiobook narrator with fourteen titles on Audible, including the espionage series The Disavowed, and the author and narrator of Sam on the Way.

Each audiobook page lists the author, length, release date, publisher, a sample and store links (Audible, Apple Books, Amazon). Facts come from Audible's catalogue. Every page has a Markdown twin at index.md, linked below.

## Audiobooks
